cleavage_agent: Overnight on-bead digestion of affinity-purified (AP) complexes was performed using 500 ng trypsin in 20 mM Tris–HCl pH8.0 at 37°C.
collision_energy: The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell and analyzed in the linear ion trap with a target value of 1e4 and a normalized collision energy at 30 V.
enrichment_method: Single-step affinity purification (AP) was performed in quadruplicate as previously described for humans, with slight modifications.
fragmentation_method: The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell and analyzed in the linear ion trap with a target value of 1e4 and a normalized collision energy at 30 V.
ionization_type: The HPLC system was coupled to Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) through a Nanospray Flex Ion Source.
labeling: inferred: Precursor intensity-based protein quantification was done essentially as described in earlier publications by calculating iBAQ (intensity-Based Absolute Quantification) values.
mass_analyzer: Full scan MS survey spectra (m/z 360–1550) in profile mode were acquired in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 120 000 and a target value of 4e5. The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell and analyzed in the linear ion trap with a target value of 1e4 and a normalized collision energy at 30 V.
